Package com.tonic.analysis.simulation.listener

Class CompositeListener

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.tonic.analysis.simulation.listener.CompositeListener
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    SimulationListener
    public class CompositeListener
extends Object
implements SimulationListener
    Simulation listener that forwards every callback to its children in order, so several listeners can be registered as one.
